svg.aria-label: Isometric infrastructure diagram of gocdnext on a deep teal-navy grid lit by neon-teal flow lines. Source icon tiles (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) emit an HMAC-verified webhook into a tiered control-plane tower (HTTP API, scheduler) backed by a Postgres cylinder that wakes agents via LISTEN/NOTIFY, and a floating Next.js dashboard screen. A bidirectional gRPC stream links the tower to an execution fleet of server racks running Kubernetes pods, a macOS host and OCI plugins, which deploys through ArgoCD to Kubernetes clusters and app stores. A vault tile injects secrets at dispatch and a second dashboard screen collects OpenTelemetry traces and Prometheus metrics. Red chevrons travel the lines to show data in motion.
